なら俺が、

pages.en:
Protect Illya.

I cannot reach them both.

Tohsaka has Archer. Illya has no one.

Then I have to—

I have to take Berserker's place—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’ll protect Illya.
I can’t try to save two people.
Tohsaka has Archer, but Illya has no one.
Then…
I have to take Berserker’s place
!

pages.ja:
「イリヤ、伏せろ……！」
力ずくでイリヤを倒す。
そのまま、イリヤを隠すように覆い被さった瞬間。
視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。

pages.en:
“Illya, get down…!”

I force her to the ground.

Then, just as I throw myself over her to shield her—

my sight and every other sense are painted solid black.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Get down, Illya…!”
I tackle Illya, forcing her to the ground.
And the instant I cover her body with my own…
My vision and perception is filled with black.

体が吹き飛ばされそうだ。
凝縮し、解放された魔力の波は暴風となって森を侵す。

My body feels as though it will be blown away.

The wave of compressed, released magical energy becomes a tempest and tears through the forest.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My body is almost blown away.
The condensed and released wave of magical energy rages through the forest as a storm.

pages.ja:
視界はまっくろ。
こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
pages.jaRuby:
視界はまっくろ。

pages.en:
My vision is pitch-black.

If I can see everything this clearly and it is still dark, then a black sun must have fallen upon us.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My vision is painted black.
If it’s this dark even though I can clearly see, a black sun must have come falling down.

pages.ja: 体が、ない。
pages.jaRuby: [ruby text=じぶん]体が、ない。
pages.en: There is nothing left of me.
pages.mirrorMoon: My body’s not there.

pages.ja:
だから、きっと太陽の熱で溶かされたのだ。
体がない。
痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
pages.jaRuby:
だから、きっと太陽の熱で溶かされたのだ。
体がない。
痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
pages.en:
The sun's heat must have melted me away.

I have no body.

Worse than the pain is the sickening emptiness where all sense of touch should be.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It probably melted from the heat.
My body’s not there.
The loss of my sense of touch is more disgusting than the pain.

」

それに、右腕で懸命に抗った。
イリヤの体を右手で抱いて、とにかく地面に張り付いたのだ。

pages.en:
“Haa—aa—ah—”

But that will not do.

Without a body, I cannot protect Illya.

The black shadow is trying to carry her away.

I fight it desperately with my right arm.

I clutch Illya to me with my right hand and cling to the earth with all my strength.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha
ah
ah
”
But that’s a problem.
I can’t protect Illya unless I have a body.
The black shadow tries to take Illya.
I flail my right arm to drive it off.
Embracing her with that same arm, I press her to the ground.

pages.ja:
「は
あ」
それで、ようやく判った。
体はある。だって体がないとイリヤは守れない。
……まったく、大げさに取り乱したもんだ。
なくなったのは、左肩の向こうだけ。
じゅっ、と音をたててキレイさっぱり消え去った。
体はちゃんと残っている。残っている。

pages.en:
“Haa—ah.”

And at last, I understand.

My body is still here. It must be, or I could not protect Illya.

…Honestly. I panicked over nothing.

Only everything past my left shoulder is gone.

It vanished cleanly with a hiss.

My body is still here. It is. It is.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha
ah.”
And I finally realize.
My body’s there. My body must be there, or else I couldn’t have protected Illya.
…Man, I panicked too much.
All I lost was my left arm.
It vanished without trace.
The rest of my body is still there. It’s still there.
That’s the only part of me that vanished without trace. The rest of my body is still there.

pages.ja:
……ただ、それでも喪失感は変わらない。
"俺のすべてが崩れ去ったわけじゃないのに。でも
" まるで体がなくなってしまったと思うほど、大きく何かが欠けてしまった。

pages.en:
…And yet the sense of loss has not changed.

“It isn't as though everything I am has crumbled away. But—”

Something immense is missing, so immense that it feels as though my whole body is gone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…But I still have the sense of loss.
‘I haven’t lost all of me. But
’
I only lost one of the two.
But it feels like I lost my whole body.

赤い外套を真っ赤にして、今にも消えそうなほど、弱っている。

What… happened to Tohsaka?

Archer is… there.

His red coat drenched a deeper crimson, he has grown so faint that he looks ready to vanish at any moment.
pages.mirrorMoon:
What… happened to Tohsaka?
Archer is… there.
His red cloak is painted a deeper red, and he’s so weakened that he might disappear in the next second.

なんで、ここに彼女が、いるんだろう。

Why is she here?

正気ですか。そんな事をすれば、貴方は」
「考えるまでもない。何もしなければ消えるのは二人だが、移植すれば確実に一人は助かる。
……どのみちこの体は限界だ。このまま消えるというのなら、これを呉れてやったところで変わるまい」

pages.en:
“—Are you in your right mind? If you do such a thing, you will—”

“There is nothing to consider. If we do nothing, two people will disappear. If we perform the transplant, one is certain to survive.

“…This body has reached its limit in any case. If it will vanish as things stand, giving it to him changes nothing.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Have you gone mad? If you do such a thing, you will…”
“I do not even need to think about it. Two will disappear if I do nothing, but one can be saved if we transplant it.
…This body is almost dead anyway. If I am to disappear, it will not make a difference even if
my arm is cut off.”
I give this away.”

pages.jaRuby: アーチャーと、ライダーが、話して、いる。
pages.en: Archer and Rider are talking.
pages.mirrorMoon: Archer and Rider are talking.

……何がどうなっているのか。
あいつは、最後に、
「通常ならば死ぬ。肉の身に霊体をつなげては助からない。だがオレとその男は特例だ。凛が目を覚ましたら、うまく処置をしてくれるだろう」
遠坂の髪を、一度だけ、愛しげに梳いていた。

pages.en:
…What is happening?

At the very end, he—

“Ordinarily, it would kill him. A spiritual body cannot be joined to living flesh. But that man and I are exceptions. Once Rin awakens, she will know how to treat him properly.”

—runs his fingers tenderly through Tohsaka's hair, just once.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…What the hell is going on?
And in the end…
“One would normally die. One cannot survive after attaching a spirit body to the human body. But the boy and I are an exception. Rin should treat him appropriately once she wakes up.”
He tenderly runs his fingers through Tohsaka’s hair.

pages.ja:
視界が暗くなっていく。
森に黒い太陽はもうない。
なら、これは。
俺の意識に、暗い闇が落ちてきたのか。
「
ここまでか。達者でな、遠坂」
そんな俺みたいな声で、アーチャーは別離を告げていた。

pages.en:
—My vision is growing dark.

The black sun is no longer in the forest.

Then this must be darkness falling over my consciousness.

“—So this is as far as I go. Take care, Tohsaka.”

In a voice so much like mine, Archer bids her farewell.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My vision fades to black.
The dark sun no longer shines on the forest.
Then…
The darkness must be falling on my consciousness.
“
So this is it. Farewell, Tohsaka.”
Archer bids farewell in a voice that sounds just like mine.
